## Goal

Describe the user task or internal problem, the current obstacle and the intended result.

## Scope and acceptance criteria

- [ ] Define observable completion criteria and relevant validation.

## Design guidance

Follow the [shared design guidance](https://github.com/IanSzymanski/squidware/blob/main/docs/DESIGN_GUIDANCE.md), which consolidates the audit direction. Apply the relevant sections; internal-only work may record why visual review is not applicable.

- [ ] Record applicable guidance and supporting review evidence in this issue or the implementation PR, or explain why it is not applicable.
- [ ] Document deviations and their resolution; a link alone does not establish compliance.

## Dependencies and release planning

Identify existing related issues, hard prerequisites and the appropriate unpublished release. Check for duplicate scope before creating another issue. New open implementation scope requires reconciliation into release-plan.json and its GitHub milestone; unassigned scope remains visible and blocks publication.

Priority, importance, remaining total input/output token effort and active rank follow the [maintained queue policy](https://github.com/IanSzymanski/squidware/blob/main/docs/IMPLEMENTATION_QUEUE.md).
